question: What is the antonym of "Egalitarian"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Biased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Egalitarian"** refers to the belief in or advocacy for equality, especially in terms of rights and opportunities. (समानतावादी)
 
 
• **Example:** An egalitarian society ensures that everyone has equal access to education and healthcare.
 

 
• The word **"Biased"** means showing prejudice or favoritism towards one side or group, leading to unequal treatment. (पक्षपाती)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge's decision was biased, favoring the defendant unfairly over the plaintiff.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "Egalitarian" is "Biased."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Biased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fair** (न्यायपूर्ण): Treating people equally without favoritism or discrimination.
 
 
• **Example:** The mediator ensured a fair resolution to the dispute.
 
 

 
• **Democratic** (लोकतांत्रिक): Relating to a system of government by the whole population or all eligible members.
 
 
• **Example:** A democratic country allows its citizens to vote freely in elections.
 
 

 
• **Equitable** (न्यायसंगत): Fair and impartial, ensuring justice and equal treatment.
 
 
• **Example:** The distribution of resources should be equitable among all members of society.
